tools.name: asp_calculate_room_acoustics
tools.description: Find out how much echo a room is likely to have and how much of its walls and ceiling is worth covering. Give the room's length, width and ceiling height in feet and what the room is used for. Returns an estimated echo time in seconds with a plain rating for speech, and the share of walls and ceiling Acoustic Sound Panels suggests covering as a starting point. These are estimates for planning, based on a plain rectangular room. A Free Room Analysis gives the team's recommended layout.

length_ft.description: Room length in feet, 4 to 400. Decimals are fine.

width_ft.description: Room width in feet, 4 to 400. Decimals are fine.

ceiling_height_ft.description: Ceiling height in feet, 6 to 30. Decimals are fine.

room_use.description: What the room is used for.

tools.name: asp_recommend_panels
tools.description: See how many Acoustic Sound Panels to plan for in a room and what they cost today. Give the room's length, width and ceiling height in feet and what the room is used for. Returns a starting panel size and count, the estimated echo before and after, exact current prices from the store when they are available, the shipping statement that applies, and a link to the product page. Panels are priced as Burch Fabrics Prime Time, and other fabrics show their own exact prices on the product page.

length_ft.description: Room length in feet, 4 to 400. Decimals are fine.

width_ft.description: Room width in feet, 4 to 400. Decimals are fine.

ceiling_height_ft.description: Ceiling height in feet, 6 to 30. Decimals are fine.

room_use.description: What the room is used for.

tools.name: asp_start_free_room_analysis
tools.description: Ask the Acoustic Sound Panels team for a Free Room Analysis: a recommended layout and one written quote for the room. Before calling, ask the person for their first name, email address and ZIP code, and get a clear yes to sharing them with Acoustic Sound Panels for this request. Nothing is ordered or charged. Returns a confirmation and, for a new request, a personal link for adding photos, room dimensions or a short video.

last_name.description: The person's last name, if they gave one.

email.description: The email address where the team should follow up.

consent.description: Must be true. Set it only after the person has said yes to sharing their name and email with Acoustic Sound Panels for this request.

length_ft.description: Room length in feet, 4 to 400. Decimals are fine.

width_ft.description: Room width in feet, 4 to 400. Decimals are fine.

ceiling_height_ft.description: Ceiling height in feet, 6 to 30. Decimals are fine.

room_use.description: What the room is used for.

zip.description: US ZIP code where the room is, 5 digits.

goals.description: What the person wants fixed, in their words, for example echo or recording quality. Up to 500 characters. No links, email addresses or phone numbers.

tools.name: asp_get_scan_link
tools.description: Get a way to capture a room for Acoustic Sound Panels: the Acoustic Sound Panels app for iPhone Pro and iPad Pro models with LiDAR. A personal link for sending photos, room dimensions or video comes with a Free Room Analysis request.
